title: pygridsynth: A fast numerical tool for ancilla-free Clifford+T synthesis
summary: We present pygridsynth, an open-source Python library for ancilla-free approximate Clifford+$T$ synthesis that runs in $O(\log(1/ε))$ for precision $ε$. For $n=1, 2$ qubits, the library builds upon established efficient and high-precision synthesis routines, such as nearly optimal $Z$-rotation synthesis and magnitude approximation. For $n\ge 3$ qubits, we introduce a partial-decomposition technique that generalizes the magnitude approximation, reducing constant factors in the $T$-count as $(\frac{21}{8}\cdot 4^n - \frac{9}{2}\cdot 2^n + 9)\log_2(1/ε) + o(\log(1/ε))$.
